Wondering about millets?

Let’s start with
the simple things.

A few helpful answers before you head into the kitchen.

More questions, more answers ↗
Which are the five Siridhanya millets?
The five Siridhanya millets featured by Millets Zone are Foxtail, Browntop, Barnyard, Kodo, and Little millet.
What can I make with millets?
The recipe collection includes rice, roti, idli, dosa, pongal, biryani, pulav, poori, sweets, bread, and cookies. Millet rice can be served with curries, chutneys, or sambar.
Do I need to soak millets before cooking?
The cooking introduction recommends soaking unpolished grains for 5–8 hours, or overnight. Individual recipes give different instructions; follow the notes for the dish you are making.
What does “unpolished” mean?
The source describes unpolished millets as de-husked grains with their bran layer retained during cleaning and processing.
